q: How do I find the right command without guessing Taskfile targets?
a:
Use the Task Oracle:
```bash
bash scripts/vda.sh oracle 'deploy mentolder'
```
Never hardcode task commands.

q: Which command shows the worker pool health on the Windows side?
a:
Probe the pool directly:
```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
```
Expect 200 before dispatching work.

q: Why does env-resolve fail when I execute it directly?
a: scripts/env-resolve.sh must be sourced, never executed. See docs/agent-guide/reference.md for the calling convention.

q: Where do I rotate the GitHub token after a leak?
a:

```bash

```

q: What branch prefix and merge style do I use for a bugfix?
a:
Branches fix/* per AGENTS.md, squash-merge only:
```bash
git checkout -b fix/rail-health-T900978
```

q: Which GPU hosts the 27B orchestrator rail?
a:
The 27B rail runs on :1919. Stop it before training:
```bash
systemctl --user stop qwen38-gsq-iq3xxs
```
